newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand moderate.
Wk to date - 70,700 last week - 73,200 last year - 68,000
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1310 lbs 63.00, pen 62.50; few 1050 lbs with light end 62.00. Dressed basis - few Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 103.00.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1140 lbs 63.00; few Select with end Choice 63.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1100-1125 lb heifers and heiferettes 61.00-63.00; pen Select and Choice 980 lb heifers 62.50.

Sales confirmed on 29,800 slaughter steers and 24,300 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 70,700 head confirmed including 17,300 head or about 24 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
